About Me

Hi, I'm Sathya — a certified director, writer & film architect, trained at L V Prasad College of Media Studies. From Madurai, based in Chennai. I spent years as a software engineer before cinema pulled me in for good. I write. I visualise. I execute. Short films and pilots came first; my debut feature is now halfway through its shoot.

Director's note

How I make films

"I write in allegory — every story stands for something bigger than itself. I plan the cut before I roll the camera, so every shot already knows where it belongs. And I direct with my body, not my mouth: if I can't show an actor the feeling, I have no business asking for it. Sound and music aren't added at the end; they're written into the bones of the scene. That's the whole craft for me — meaning underneath, precision on set, and a film that makes you laugh and jump in the same breath."
SathyaCertified Director & Writer · L V Prasad College of Media Studies
